add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__)

spec2def(d3dxof.dll d3dxof.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

add_idl_reg_objects(d3dxof registry d3dxof.idl)

# d3dxof.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/d3dxof-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(d3dxof_shims OBJECT d3dxof.c main.c mszip.c parsing.c)
target_link_libraries(d3dxof_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload dxguid uuid oldnames libole32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(d3dxof_shims)
add_dependencies(d3dxof_shims wineheaders)
set(D3DXOF_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/d3dxof/d3dxof_r.o)
add_cargo_module(d3dxof d3dxof-cargo d3dxof.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS d3dxof_shims psdk d3dxof_r ${D3DXOF_REUSED} uuid_sources)
